name: Phi-4-mm-inst-asr-turkish-3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A fine-tune of microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct on 1300 hours of Turkish audio - same config.json and tensor set as the base (5.574B, Phi-4-mm's audio+text stack). Not a new base model. Recorded because the card's Training Results section prints before/after fine-tuning on the same evaluation, under the base's own language-agnostic ASR prompt: WER 153.84 -> 64.76 and CER 82.57 -> 29.85. Before-fine-tuning is the base model itself, so this is a base comparison, though it is a bullet list rather than a columned table. Caveats: the WER above 100 is printed as-is (the card's own phrasing), no dataset name/split/decoding is given, and this is the third in a family - the sibling ysdede/Phi-4-mm-inst-asr-turkish is already a record with WER 47.57 using the better Turkish prompt. Licence mit, repo created 2025-03-02.
